source_version.notes: Thresholds are product defaults for pilot work; tune with real office document counts and retrieval logs.

context_first.description: Agent works directly inside the project folder, like a coding agent in a small repo.
context_first.storage: files + explicit context manifest + decision ledger
context_first.retrieval: direct file reads, manifest search, targeted extraction
context_first.economics: no index build/refresh cost; best for fast feasibility and small mandates

hybrid_index.description: Keep the project folder as source of truth, add a lightweight index for selected documents.
hybrid_index.storage: files + manifest + extracted metadata/index + decision ledger
hybrid_index.retrieval: selector first, then indexed project snippets with file/hash references
hybrid_index.economics: index only stable/high-value subsets instead of all project noise

project_rag_db.description: Dedicated project retrieval/database memory for large, long, multi-actor projects.
project_rag_db.storage: versioned evidence store + vector/index layer + structured graph + decision ledger
project_rag_db.retrieval: scoped project RAG/DB with source hashes, versions, phase and actor filters
project_rag_db.economics: higher setup cost justified by retrieval frequency, coordination risk, and long project memory

graduation_rules.condition: Use by default for villas, small transformations, early feasibility, or any project below hybrid triggers.
graduation_rules.rationale: Indexing overhead is not justified; direct context is cheaper and easier to audit.

graduation_rules.condition: Escalate when one hybrid threshold is crossed and the same information is queried repeatedly.
graduation_rules.rationale: A lightweight index pays off once repeated retrieval starts costing more than index upkeep.

graduation_rules.condition: Escalate when at least two RAG thresholds are crossed, or when public procurement/formal BIM governance requires long-lived evidence.
graduation_rules.rationale: Large coordination risk justifies a persistent project memory layer.

graduation_rules.condition: Project facts, regulatory facts, and general knowledge must keep separate source IDs and trust states.
graduation_rules.rationale: Prevents project assumptions from being rendered as reusable regulation.
